core_capabilities.audio_transcript_versioning: Multi-version transcript tracking (v1, v2, ...) with synchronized timed narration cues, speaker attribution, section titles, and artisan human verification timestamps.
core_capabilities.per_use_media_consent: Granular scope enforcement (full_public, educational_only, preview_only, revoked) linked to written consent agreement references and audit logging.
core_capabilities.right_to_erasure: Right to erasure / right to be forgotten under Decree 13/2023/ND-CP and GDPR, scrubbed media asset links, and redacting transcript texts with immutable audit trails.
core_capabilities.cultural_context_preservation: Preserves intangible cultural context, interviewer attribution, recording location, date, and community tradition epistemic certainty.
core_capabilities.negative_abuse_invariant: When an oral history recording is revoked or erased, public endpoint immediately rejects access with HTTP 403 / 410, returning anti-stale cache headers (no-cache, no-store) and registering immediate invalidation in local memory and persistent CDN revocation registry (AssetCacheRevocation).

endpoints.description: Create a new oral history recording draft with initial transcript and cultural context
List oral history recordings scoped to authenticated partner workshop with multi-tenant isolation
Public / learner retrieval of approved oral history and transcript with fail-closed revocation defense
Add a new versioned transcript with timed cues, change summaries, and artisan verification
Update per-use media consent scope, agreement reference, and notes
Revoke consent or request erasure, immediately invalidating CDN caches and scrubbed data

scenarios_covered: Negative abuse: Revoked audio immediately unavailable publicly (HTTP 403) and CDN/local caches invalidated with no-cache/no-store headers and AssetCacheRevocation ledger registration
Multi-version transcript evolution: v1 -> v2 versioning, synchronized timed cues, and artisan verification metadata
Right to erasure: Scrubbing of voice audio URLs, content hashes, and transcript redactions under Decree 13/2023/ND-CP
Partner oral history studio: Multi-tenant provider scoping, creator binding, and listing isolation
verification_results.migration_safety: Alembic single head verified (0084_rbpc_oral_history_consent_studio), strictly additive operations, 0 destructive violations
verification_results.frontend_type_check: tsc --noEmit passed cleanly with 0 type errors
